rule: For one stated document requirement, check each rule below and emit one candidate per implied requirement the text does not already satisfy. Read the text first and prune already-satisfied candidates before generating anything.

categories.name: term-defined
categories.rule: Every term is defined before its first use.
categories.probe: Grep earlier lines for a definition before proposing a new term item.

categories.name: xref-resolves
categories.rule: Every cross-reference resolves to a section that exists.
categories.probe: Read the referenced heading before proposing a new cross-reference item.

categories.name: toc-exists
categories.rule: Every chapter in the table of contents exists as a file.
categories.probe: Check the chapter file exists before proposing a new chapter item.

categories.name: figure-referenced
categories.rule: Every figure is referenced by the text.
categories.probe: Grep the text for the figure label before proposing a new figure item.

categories.name: table-referenced
categories.rule: Every table is referenced by the text.
categories.probe: Grep the text for the table label before proposing a new table item.

categories.name: example-exists
categories.rule: Every example promised in the text exists.
categories.probe: Read the promised example before proposing a new example item.

categories.name: exercise-count
categories.rule: Every chapter ends with the promised number of exercises.
categories.probe: Count the exercises at the chapter end before proposing a new exercise item.
